scope: Current main-game logic; functional gameplay actions and autonomous rules
counting_rules: A distinct functional gameplay action or autonomous rule is one inventory entry.
Start/input/finish callbacks of one interaction are not automatically separate mechanics.
Different recipes, items, jobs, skills, symptoms, dialogue lines and story nodes are content variants.
Decision stages with independent world consequences may be separate entries.
Queries, debug/configuration APIs, validation, transaction safety, rendering and save/load are excluded.
Shared routing and player/NPC adapters are not additional mechanics; distinct autonomous decision processes may be.
This is an explicit audit classification, not an engine metric or proof of complete content and test coverage.
additional_technical_systems: Save/load, including manual and automatic slots
verification: Static inventory with resolved source symbols. Prior main-game run: 676 assertions, 0 failed. No claim of individually testing all listed entries.
excluded_historical_paths: social_rules.autonomy/_review_partners/_consider_betrayal are bypassed while the current HumanAgency is enabled; old independent behavior paths are not extra mechanics.
